title: Contact Center Intelligence & CSAT Optimization
thesis: Snowflake processes contact center interactions from Amazon Connect, classifies customer intent with AI, scores sentiment for CSAT prediction, and enables natural language analytics — replacing fragmented WFM tools with one platform

talking_points: Six hundred twenty thousand interactions processed this month across 35 client accounts.
Five accounts running below CSAT SLA — combined contract value ₱890M.
Overall NPS dropped 7 points this month — billing complaints up 34%.
tabs.call_out: 5 accounts below CSAT SLA — ₱890M in contracts at risk

transition.line: Let's drill into what's driving customer dissatisfaction.

talking_points: AI_SENTIMENT processed 450,000 transcripts — 23% scored negative this month.
Billing intent category shows -0.42 average sentiment — worst performing.
Top complaint: 'unexpected charges' appearing in 4,200 interactions this week.
show: Display word cloud of negative interactions
tabs.call_out: Billing complaints driving 60% of negative sentiment — one root cause

transition.line: The pattern is clear. Let's see how this maps to individual agents.

talking_points: 142 agents in bottom quartile for sentiment scores — candidates for coaching.
Cortex Complete generates personalized coaching plans based on interaction patterns.
Agents who completed AI-recommended coaching improved CSAT 18% within 30 days.
show: Click bottom-quartile agent for coaching plan
tabs.call_out: AI coaching improves CSAT 18% in 30 days — measurable ROI

transition.line: Let the VP ask the system directly.

talking_points: Patricia asks: 'Which account has the highest escalation rate this week?'
Cortex Analyst writes the query, returns: GlobalTech account — 8.7% escalation rate.
Follow-up: 'What are customers complaining about on GlobalTech?' — searches 12,000 transcripts instantly.
show: Type: 'Which account has highest escalation rate?'
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL analytics + transcript search

talking_points: Amazon Connect feeds interactions → Snowpipe Streaming → AI enrichment → real-time dashboards.
AI_SENTIMENT + AI_CLASSIFY replace Amazon Comprehend — same accuracy, zero data movement.
Philippines handles 70% of world's voice BPO. This monitors 620K interactions/month.
tabs.call_out: One platform — ingest, enrich, analyze, alert

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Philippine contact center intelligence.
